title: Add F# semantic callers and callees
outcome: Phoenix v0.12.88 provides compiler-semantic, position-only F# callers across the selected closure and proven workspace dependents, and body-local F# callees, using typed AssemblyContents evidence, the shared keepAssemblyContents runtime, honest workspace coverage, a closed callKind contract, and no heuristic target inference.
acceptance: Both operations reuse the v0.12.87 gate, pinned snapshot, capture session, evaluated dependent discovery where applicable, filters, binary verification, diagnostics, exact/lower-bound confidence rules, and the same four-entry fingerprint-keyed keepAssemblyContents runtime; per-context results merge only after binary verification

BuildInfo.Version is 0.12.88, fsharp-callers-workspace and fsharp-callees-body are unique features[] entries, fsharpSemanticTools lists both, unsupported-boundary prose leaves only hierarchy unavailable, no new or lowered limit is introduced, and IndexBuilder.SchemaVersion is unchanged

Callers positioned on override or explicit-interface implementations retain that target and disclose dispatchSlots plus dynamic-dispatch guidance; positions on abstract/interface slots return slot-dispatch callers

F# callees accepts an exact position on or inside a function/member/constructor body and reports compiler-resolved calls inside that body including nested lambdas, local functions, object expressions, primary-constructor do/let bindings, constructions, union cases, active patterns, operators, and computation-expression builder calls; coverage scope is selected_fsharp_body_with_project_reference_closure_targets

F# callers accepts only an exact compile-owned .fs/.fsi position and reports every typed body site that invokes or hands off the compiler-resolved target across the selected closure, distinct declaring projects, and proven workspace dependents; sites are globally deduplicated by physical path+range+callKind and TFMs are accumulated

F# mode requires path+line+column and rejects C# selectors/positive maxProjects with incompatible_filter; C# mode rejects F# projectPath/targetFramework/includeTests/includeGenerated arguments symmetrically without otherwise changing C# behavior

MCP envelopes preserve the C# callers[].caller+callSites and callees[].callee+callLines cores, add F# range/callKind/project/TFM details and complete totals outside budgeted lists, preserve selected target/body identity, and disclose filters, coverage, truncation, contexts, diagnostics, timing, and retry metadata
Release build has zero warnings/errors; full suite, external Roslyn/F# MCP gate, website verifier, formatting/diff checks, and same-session dual adversarial review are green before commit

Tests decisively cover cross-project callers, direct/partial/pipeline/first-class/composition cases, overload exactness, recursion, members/properties/constructors/union cases/active patterns/operators/CE, nested callee bodies, TFM dedupe, filters, deadlines, discovery and binary failures, quotation/TraitCall boundaries, C# envelope parity, argument rejection, response budgets, feature discovery, metadata, v0.12.88, and unchanged schema

The closed callKind set is directApplication, partialApplication, pipelineApplication, computationExpression, firstClassReference, construction, unionCaseConstruction, activePattern, operator, and indirectApplication; first-class and composition operands count without interprocedural flow propagation, partial applications and pipelines count, and SRTP TraitCall is never guessed

The eight existing fsharp_workspace_* causes retain their meanings and a ninth fsharp_workspace_trait_calls_unresolved cause has an emitter/coverage field, exact-confidence classifier entry, docs/design.md table row, and decisive classifier/feature regression

completion.summary: Delivered and committed Phoenix v0.12.88 compiler-semantic F# callers and body-local callees, with position-only contracts, workspace-dependent caller coverage, dispatch metadata, a closed callKind vocabulary, truthful coverage/truncation shaping, versioned capability discovery, the deterministic gate wrapper, and decisive regressions. Commit 8a0ede51693945c528117d1b57dfd3662e341385 contains exactly the audited 22-path packet; no push.
